verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team-chat product, so threading applies. The evidence only implies threads exist: the public benchmark includes a "reply-to-thread" task graded on "where the reply lands," and the README says agents "post the threads." No doc describes humans or admins replying in threads, and the evidence is agent-centric and indirect. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of human thread replies, a description of how threads stay attached to the parent message in the UI or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
